recorded_from_commit_note: Recorded against this card's own implementation: FR-032's horizontal placement clause is reversed from centred to right-aligned mirrored by parity (owner reading (b) — flush with the usable area's outer margin on both parities), and a 2x2cm placeholder QR icon (owner option 2(b): a generic grid-of-squares glyph, never claiming to scan) is reserved and drawn on puzzle pages (single and two-up) wherever the new geometry leaves room for one, margin-side first, foot as a fallback. Pages 5, 7 and 9 (the two-up page and the two single-puzzle pages) move for both reasons; every other page is unchanged — see changed_pages_note.
read_back_through: tests.helpers.pdf_pages.pdf_pages — the pages decoded out of the exported interior PDF, not the in-memory bitmaps
why_a_new_baseline: CARD-204 reverses FR-032's centred horizontal placement to right-aligned (mirrored by parity) and adds a placeholder QR icon to puzzle pages. Measured directly against the CARD-200 recording (git-stash diff of the renderer, and a page-by-page digest comparison): pages 5, 7 and 9 move (the two-up page and the book's two single-puzzle pages, all of which have real horizontal spare to move by, and all of which gain the QR icon). Pages 11 and 12 (CARD-202's packed answer pages) do not move: they are centred by a tile-local formula FR-032's page-wide clause never covered. Page 13 (Snowflake's own full answer page) does not move either, but as a coincidence of this puzzle's own geometry (it is exactly page-fit-bound on both axes, so its spare is exactly 0 and the old centred formula and the new flush one land on the same pixel) rather than a structural exemption — a Snowflake-sized puzzle with any spare at all would move like pages 5/7/9 do. Pages 1 and 2 (the guide) move too, by a small, documented, incidental rounding scatter: their own worked-example diagrams reuse compute_layout's placed-page branch for cell/rule consistency (ADR-0036/R2), and that branch's per-boundary independent rounding depends on the absolute anchor's own fractional part, which this card's formula changes even though the diagrams themselves are cropped and pasted at a fixed, card-independent position. See tests/test_book_pdf_memory.py's TestBookPdfMemory_NonDrawingPagesAreByteIdentical for the test that verifies all of this directly, and this card's own Worktree notes (meta/kanban/cards/CARD-204.md) for the full reasoning flagged to the owner/architect.
warning: This is evidence of what the book PDF looks like with CARD-204's right-alignment and placeholder QR icon in place. It must NEVER be regenerated to make a test fail less: a digest that no longer matches means a page's ink changed, and an interior_bytes that no longer matches means the written file changed. If a later card deliberately changes either, it records a NEW baseline in a commit of its own, with its own card number, and says so here.
interior_colorspace_note: What every page of this interior declares (CARD-147's own fact, unaffected by CARD-201). NOT the same as each page entry's 'mode' below, which is 'RGB' and always will be: that field is what tests.helpers.pdf_pages.pdf_pages normalises every page to before digesting it, regardless of the file's own declared colour space.
font_fingerprint_note: This machine's Arial-or-fallback fingerprint, reproduced before this file was written (tests.helpers.book_corpus.font_fingerprint). A machine with a different fingerprint skips the font_dependent_pages below rather than failing on them.
font_dependent_pages_note: Both guide pages (1, 2), the new TOC page (3, CARD-200: its title and every entry are set through _guide_face, the same Arial-or-fallback path the guide and divider pages already use), the three level dividers (4, 6, 8) and the SOLUTIONS divider (10) are machine-lettered. None of the three packed/full answer pages (11-13) are machine-lettered -- a packed slot's band and caption letter in the packaged DejaVu Sans, and so does every page's own new folio (CARD-200: it reuses _band_font, the same packaged face, exactly as the answer caption does -- G-4's reuse, not a new font path), so the folio never makes an otherwise machine-safe page machine-dependent.
interior_bytes_note: The black-and-white interior of this book: 3439483 bytes, where CARD-200's own recording held 3420073. The difference is pages 5/7/9's repositioned drawings and their new QR-icon ink, plus pages 1-2's sub-pixel rounding scatter (see why_a_new_baseline).
changed_pages_note: Pages 5, 7, 9 (right-alignment + new QR icon) and 1, 2 (the guide's own documented sub-pixel rounding scatter, see why_a_new_baseline) differ from the CARD-200 recording. Pages 3, 4, 6, 8, 10 (TOC and dividers), 11, 12 (packed answer pages, a tile-local formula untouched by this card) and 13 (Snowflake's full answer page, page-fit-bound with zero spare on this puzzle) are byte-identical to it.
